content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 13 (p0047) is the only non-solicitation provision in the agreement. It binds Clear Capital, so it is responsive to NOSOLICIT.

- **Already at fallback:** mutual ("Neither party shall"), scope limited to "personnel who have had direct involvement with the Services", and solicitation-only (no no-hire).
- **Fails fallback:** duration runs for the entire term plus one year after termination rather than 12 months after the individual's involvement ends, and there are no carve-outs for general advertisements or unsolicited approaches.
- **Redline (fallback target, validated ok:true):** re-anchored the period to "twelve (12) months after the end of such personnel's involvement with the Services" and inserted a single short carve-out sentence covering general advertisements and unsolicited approaches; the consent mechanic and all other wording are preserved verbatim.
